item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's grandmother makes butter at home in their village kitchen. She adds a little water to fresh dahi (curd) and churns it with a wooden madhani until white lumps of butter collect on top.

Which statements about this method of separation are correct?

1  Churning is a suitable method for obtaining butter from curd.
2  Churning works because agitating the curd makes the lighter fat separate from the liquid.
3  Churning can also be used to separate salt dissolved in water.
4  The liquid left behind after the butter separates is buttermilk.

statements.text: Churning is a suitable method for obtaining butter from curd.
Churning works because agitating the curd makes the lighter fat separate from the liquid.
Churning can also be used to separate salt dissolved in water.
The liquid left behind after the butter separates is buttermilk.
